notes: The *become* of *shall become tributary* goes to the written יִהְיוּ, which leaves the resultative לְ of s023 unrepresented rather than holding rule 49's frame — rule 21's ruling for `הָיָה לְ`.
The second הָיָה keeps the frame's *that* because no waw opens its apodosis, unlike the first frame in this verse (rule 45).
